parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposures are largely absent. Home passports are accepted, and no facility exclusion, presentation offence or police targeting of trans people is documented. Hate-crime aggravation is applied in practice: a 2026 first-instance fine and a 2026 park-gang case with an adult prison sentence. Strong national acceptance is documented, though the 2016 and 2013 attitude baselines are dated. Deductions: the capital region repealed its non-discrimination law and trans recognitions, which weakens local recourse; the legal basis for facility access is unsourced; custody and detention placement are unknown; and no trans-specific violence rate exists, so violence is only partly assessed. Historical persecution is dated and mainly concerns residents, so it carries little weight. The 2013 ministerial remark is also dated. Overall: Low Risk tier, held below the top because of the regional repeal and open questions.
